title: Taiwanese Association of America Pittsburgh 匹茲堡 台灣同鄉會
content_html:
The Taiwanese Association of America Pittsburgh (TAAP) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations in the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania area.

TAAP was established in 1969 as a 501(c) non-profit organization, making it one of the longer-standing TAA chapters in the country. Pittsburgh attracted Taiwanese students and professionals beginning in the 1960s, in part due to the presence of universities such as Carnegie Mellon University and the University of Pittsburgh.
